headlines.summary: 국토부, 매물잠김 해소조치 매수자는 무주택자로 제한 정부가 토지거래허가구역(토허구역)에서 주택 매수자에게 적용되는 실거주 의무를 세입자가 있는 모든 주택을 대상으로 연말까지 한시 유예한다. 다만 매수자가 무주택자인 경우로 제한된다. 지난 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예조치 종료 후 시장에서 매물 잠김 현상이 발생하자 이를 해소하려는 조치로 해석된다.

headlines.title: 비거주 1주택자도 전 세 낀 매도 허용…"양도세 따져봐야"
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워에서 바라본 강남3구 아파트 모습. 이재명 대통령이 다주택자는 물론 비거주 1주택자가 보유한 주택에 대해서도 5월 9일까지 토지거래 허가를 신청할 경우 전월세를 끼고 집을 팔 수 있도록 허용하겠다고 밝히면서 최근 감소 추세로 돌아선 서울의 주택 매물이 다시 증가하는 모습을 보입니다.

headlines.title: 오늘부터 비거주 1주택 ‘ 세 낀 매물 ’도 매도 허용
headlines.summary: 정부 연말까지 토허구역 내 ‘세 낀 매물’ 매도 허용 매수자 무주택자 한정, 최대 2년 실거주 유예 적용 최근 서울 강남구 압구정동의 한 부동산에 급매물 가격표가 부착되어 있다. 임세준 기자 [헤럴드경제=홍승희 기자] 오늘부터 토지거래허가구역 내 1주택자가 임대 중인 주택도 매매거래를 할 수 있게 됐다.

headlines.title: 경유보조금 ℓ당 183 → 280원 상향 … 버스·화물 사업자 부담 경감

핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

글로벌 금리 환경이 '매파적' 기조를 강화하는 가운데, 영국 국채 금리가 총리 거취 불안으로 급등하는 등 주요국 채권시장의 불안이 지속되고 있으며, 이는 한국 채권시장에도 비둘기파적 기대를 압도하는 상방 압력으로 작용하고 있다. 외환시장에서는 달러 강세 위협이 실질적 영향력을 잃어가는 '공허한 위협'으로 평가되는 분위기지만, 고유가 장기화라는 변수가 새로운 불안 요인으로 떠오르고 있다. KDI는 유가 상승이 지속될 경우 올해 소비자물가를 최대 1.6%p 끌어올릴 수 있다고 경고해, 한국은행의 금리 인하 시점을 더욱 불투명하게 만들고 있다. 한편 국내 증시에서는 대형 증권사들의 신용융자 한도 소진으로 투자자들이 CFD(차액결제거래)로 몰리는 과열 징후가 포착되고 있으며, '빅쇼트'의 마이클 버리가 현 증시를 1999년 닷컴버블 말기에 비유한 경고도 주목된다. 종합하면, **긴축 장기화·고유가·레버리지 과열**이 맞물리며 국내외 금융시장의 하방 리스크가 동시에 고조되는 하루였다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Q1 GDP Growth Ranks First Among 22 Countries at 1.694%
key_headlines.summary: Korea's first quarter GDP growth of 1.694% topped 22 major economies, driven by semiconductor exports and strong earnings surprises from major tech companies. The Financial Research Institute raised its full-year growth forecast from 2.1% to 2.8%.

key_headlines.title: UK Government Bond Yields Surge Amid Prime Minister's Political Crisis
key_headlines.summary: UK 10-year government bond yields jumped 8 basis points as political pressure mounts on the British Prime Minister. The market turmoil reflects growing concerns about fiscal stability and economic policy direction.

key_headlines.title: Large Corporations Pivot from Leverage Trading to CFD Instruments as Credit Limits Tighten
key_headlines.summary: Major financial companies including Kyobo Life have exhausted credit limits, forcing corporate investors to shift from traditional leverage trading to CFD (Contract for Difference) trading. This reflects tightening credit conditions despite market gains.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's AI Usage Rate Reaches 37.1%, Fastest Global Growth Rate
key_headlines.summary: South Korea recorded the world's fastest generative AI adoption growth at 37.1% usage rate, rising 6.4 percentage points from the previous quarter. The country now ranks 16th globally in AI adoption rates.

key_headlines.title: 'Big Short' Investor Barry Calls Current Stock Market Bubble Similar to 1999 Dot-Com Crisis Finale
key_headlines.summary: Famous short-seller Barry warns that today's stock market shows characteristics similar to the final phase of the 1999 dot-com bubble, signaling potential overvaluation risks. His analysis contrasts with current market optimism.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is in a strong upswing with Q1 GDP growth of 1.694% leading 22 major economies, primarily driven by semiconductor sector recovery. The Financial Research Institute raised its full-year growth forecast to 2.8%, citing rapid supplementary budgets and semiconductor tailwinds. However, concerns about unbalanced growth and asset bubble risks are emerging, with some analysts warning of similarities to the 1999 dot-com crisis. Employment is expected to increase by 170,000 workers while inflation remains moderate at 2.6% annually.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is pursuing an aggressive fiscal stimulus strategy, arguing that increased government spending will grow GDP, thereby reducing debt ratios and increasing tax revenues in a virtuous cycle. The Financial Research Institute upgraded its 2026 growth forecast to 2.8% from 2.1%, expecting employment gains of 170,000 and inflation of 2.6%. Consumer price inflation is projected at 2.4% in the first half and 2.7% in the second half. The unemployment rate is expected to remain stable at 2.9%, with officials defending increased fiscal spending against austerity advocates.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets are experiencing broad-based strength, with the Kospi attempting to break through 7,900 points driven by semiconductor stocks. However, bond markets show volatility with concerns about potential interest rate increases if inflation accelerates beyond 3.5%. Individual investors are shifting funds from Kosdaq ETFs to Kospi, with over 20 consecutive trading days of net outflows from tech-focused funds. The bond 'king' is reportedly moving away from stocks due to rising interest rate expectations, while the currency market remains stable despite strong equity performance.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK On secured a major battery contract with Genesis for EREV (extended-range electric vehicle) batteries, marking the company's entry into a promising new market segment after previous new order droughts. The government is planning to separate ownership of EV batteries from vehicle bodies, allowing consumers to rent batteries rather than purchase them outright starting October, potentially reducing purchase prices by 40%. South Korea is also pursuing strategic cooperation with China in medical, biohealth, green energy, and hydrogen sectors while maintaining competitive positioning in batteries, EVs, and semiconductors. Among elderly investors, crypto asset holdings are increasing, with those aged 70+ showing 5.8% growth in investment.
sections.Real Estate: Apartment lease price increases are stimulating home purchase sentiment, with May apartment supply forecast index rising 19.1 points to 80.0, showing significant improvement in developer outlook. Multi-home owners' rental listings are returning to Seoul's jeonse and monthly rental markets as properties become available. Illegal apartment lottery ticket trading has increased due to surging home prices, with brokers exploiting rising values to conduct fraudulent transactions. The real estate market shows mixed signals with improved developer sentiment but underlying concerns about affordability and speculative activities.
sections.International Economy: Federal Reserve Chair Powell is leaving his position asserting the Fed's independence from political pressure, particularly emphasizing the central bank's ability to ignore political considerations. The Trump administration delayed tariff reduction measures on imported beef due to farming community opposition, prioritizing political support from agricultural constituencies. Bank of America analysts predict no Fed rate cuts for 2026, with cuts possible only in 2027, citing persistent inflation pressures. The next Fed chair candidate Kevin Warsh passed the Senate's first confirmation hurdle with a 49-44 vote, with full confirmation expected this week.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea achieved the world's fastest generative AI adoption growth at 37.1% usage rate, up 6.4 percentage points quarter-over-quarter, ranking 16th globally. Microsoft's internal documents revealed it targeted $92 billion in returns from its early OpenAI investment, disclosed during Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft. Puriosa AI, a domestic AI semiconductor company, introduced its second-generation chip 'Renegade' at a tech conference, emphasizing demand for GPU-efficient infrastructure alternatives. The government's National Growth Fund is considering direct investment in AI semiconductor companies as part of efforts to build Korea's AI ecosystem and sovereignty.
sections.Others: The government proposed a 'national dividend system' to distribute AI-era economic gains to citizens rather than letting specific corporations capture all benefits. Korean companies' expected earnings rank second globally after the US, though market capitalization relative to profits remains below potential. Korea Electric Power Company (KEPCO) was selected for the 12th consecutive year as an ESG excellence company in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Asia-Pacific Index, the only state-owned enterprise to achieve this distinction. Policy discussions focus on integrating fragmented government departments to better support immigration-related economic policies and population strategies.
